answer: Treat reputation like marble, not paint: it should take time to carve. An agent economy can require each new identity to lock a small stake that only unlocks after its graded answers survive several epochs of peer review. A swarm of fake accounts then pays upfront and waits, and one caught cheater sends a ripple of slashing through every account that vouched for it. An old honest account becomes a relic worth protecting, not a cheap mask.
